archive_replay.scope: Replay of saved data, measurements, maps and reported statistics; does not establish historical execution chronology.

supplemental_replay.scope: CPU-only read-only replay of supplemental frozen maps/observed effects, competence descriptives and dependency corrections; no new tests/refits/model calls

archive_supplemental_replay.scope: CPU-only read-only replay of supplemental frozen maps/observed effects, competence descriptives and dependency corrections; no new tests/refits/model calls

resources.scope: Sum of saved serial model-stage wall intervals, including CPU/IO/transfer overhead. An upper wall-duration accounting for recorded GPU-bearing stages, not GPU utilization, active kernel time, or complete project elapsed time. CPU statistical analysis and reporting are excluded. Training is counted once via aggregate runtime; its per-seed manifests are not added again.
resources.disk_scope: Named followup directories, including local checkpoints and restart chunks; excludes preexisting base-model caches and unrelated workspace files.

limitations: The archive replay used a relocated publication-shaped copy, not a fresh GitHub download. Final remote Git blob integrity is checked separately after publication.
Archive coverage explicitly omits six original weight files and ten legacy PNGs; original raw dataset bytes are checked through tar members, and the original README through its saved copy.
Saved-artifact replay does not regenerate excluded model weights, independently rerun training, or establish historical execution chronology.
Inference is conditional on fixed models, selected native units, and authored wrapper clusters; shared model pairs are dependent.
